title: Study of the Efficacy of Losartan on Aortic Dilatation in Patients With Marfan Syndrome
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate if losartan limits aortic dilatation in patients with Marfan syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 10 years or older
* Marfan syndrome according to international criteria Signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous surgery of the ascending aorta, or surgery planned
* Non echogenicity
* Contre-indication lactose
* Pregnancy on going or planned within 3 years
* Breast feeding
* Participation in another clinical study
* Non member of the social security or CMU
